-- Qualified leads who never booked: one nudge after 24h, a last one after 72h.
SELECT l.id AS lead_id, NULL::bigint AS appointment_id, 'nudge_24h' AS kind,
       l.name, l.email, l.service, NULL::timestamptz AS starts_at
FROM leads l
WHERE l.status = 'qualified' AND l.email IS NOT NULL
  AND l.updated_at BETWEEN now() - interval '72 hours' AND now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followups f WHERE f.lead_id = l.id AND f.kind = 'nudge_24h')
UNION ALL
SELECT l.id, NULL, 'nudge_72h', l.name, l.email, l.service, NULL
FROM leads l
WHERE l.status = 'qualified' AND l.email IS NOT NULL
  AND l.updated_at BETWEEN now() - interval '7 days' AND now() - interval '72 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followups f WHERE f.lead_id = l.id AND f.kind = 'nudge_72h')
UNION ALL
-- Booked patients: a reminder the day before.
SELECT a.lead_id, a.id, 'appt_reminder', l.name, l.email, a.service, a.starts_at
FROM appointments a JOIN leads l ON l.id = a.lead_id
WHERE a.status = 'booked' AND l.email IS NOT NULL
  AND a.starts_at BETWEEN now() + interval '1 hour' AND now() + interval '24 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followups f WHERE f.appointment_id = a.id AND f.kind = 'appt_reminder')
INSERT INTO followups (lead_id, appointment_id, kind) VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, '')::bigint, $3)
